item.title: England appoint Root and Fleming as Test cricket captain and coach
item.description:
New Era for English Cricket as Root and Fleming Take the Helm

In a move aimed at revitalizing the national team, England has appointed Joe Root as its new Test cricket captain and Stephen Fleming as head coach, following the departures of Ben Stokes and Brendon McCullum. Root, England’s all-time leading run scorer in Tests, returns to the role after Stokes retired from international cricket last month, and will lead the team in the upcoming three-Test home series against Pakistan starting on August 19.
